decisions.reason: The multi-model height-adjustable desk line is central to the firm's announced move toward flexible workplace solutions, so its investment and strategic visibility argue for persistence.
The chair family sits close to the core offer and had its own page, so it is a low-risk continuation that management will keep refreshing rather than drop.

The floor cushions lost their link to the withdrawn rug collection, which weakens their fit, but the multi-model investment and lounge-range visibility still let management attribute weak results to pandemic-era conditions.
The sofa was only mentioned on the website and so carries little visible commitment, but it fits the core upholstery offer and is likely kept as part of the range.
The high standing table supports the workplace and conference direction and had its own page, so the firm is likely to persist with it as office demand recovers.
